summary: Complaints centre on Greater Noida West's missing government hospital and services, waterlogging and drains in Dadri town and villages, and society maintenance hikes, while people appreciate new CC roads and drains that have started in Devla, Dadri town and Dujana.

positives.english: Devla village CC road construction has started, villagers had long demanded it
positives.hindi: देवला में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू हुआ, लंबे समय से मांग थी
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Jun 2026): about 238 m CC road at Devla village in Dadri assembly, Rs 27 lakh; construction just started. Article says villagers had long demanded the road and it will stop waterlogging on that path.

positives.english: CC road and pucca drain from GT Road to the railway overbridge in Dadri town
positives.hindi: जीटी रोड से ओवरब्रिज तक सीसी रोड और पक्का नाला बनने लगा
positives.basis: Raftar Today (page last updated 7 Mar 2026): about Rs 16 crore CC road and pucca drain, GT Road to railway overbridge, Dadri Nagar. Article says foundation stone laid and work launched; physical progress not confirmed. Date is the page's last-updated date.

positives.english: Foundation laid for repair of the broken Dujana to Dadri bypass road
positives.hindi: दुजाना से दादरी बाईपास तक जर्जर सड़क का शिलान्यास हुआ
positives.basis: Raftar Today (page last updated 4 May 2026): 0.650 km Dujana-Sadulapur-Kheri-Dadri bypass road, about Rs 89.24 lakh under PWD; article names Dadri assembly. Only the foundation stone is reported, not completed work.

positives.english: Road widening from Dadri towards Bulandshahr is moving fast
positives.hindi: दादरी से बुलंदशहर की ओर सड़क चौड़ीकरण का काम तेजी से चल रहा है
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (19 Sep 2026): under-construction widening with median divider, two lanes each side and drains, for the Dadri to Chitehra-Bulandshahr-Sikandarabad road; article says work is going fast. Cost not stated.

positives.english: CC road from Kulesra to Surajpur and Tilpata is under construction
positives.hindi: कुलेसरा से सूरजपुर और तिलपता तक सीसी रोड बन रही है
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (19 Sep 2026): CC road work from Kulesra to Surajpur and Tilpata 'Dadri area' is continuing with a new contractor after the earlier one was blacklisted. AC membership of Kulesra, Surajpur and Tilpata is unconfirmed (article does not name the vidhan sabha for these villages).

negatives.english: Greater Noida West has no full government hospital, only Bisrakh CHC
negatives.hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में पूरा सरकारी अस्पताल नहीं बिसरख सीएचसी ही सहारा
negatives.basis: NCR Khabar (26 Jun 2026): Bisrakh CHC is the only government facility, a 30-bed CHC; district hospital in Noida 35-40 min away, GIMS 50-60 min. Quote from NEFOWA president: no fully developed government hospital for this population. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri assembly.

negatives.english: Tilpata has waterlogging, garbage, broken road and jams at container depot
negatives.hindi: तिलपता में जलभराव, गंदगी, जर्जर सड़क और कंटेनर डिपो पर रोज़ जाम
negatives.basis: Chetna Manch (19 Sep 2026): villagers' anger in Tilpata (Dadri area, Greater Noida) lists waterlogging (जलभराव), garbage, damaged road, poor drainage and jams in front of the container depot; indefinite dharna from 20 Sep 2026. AC membership unconfirmed: article says Dadri area and Dadri sub-divisional magistrate but does not name the vidhan sabha.

negatives.english: Rain floods Dadri town, drainage has been a long-standing problem
negatives.hindi: बारिश में दादरी नगर में पानी भर जाता है, निकासी नहीं
negatives.basis: Raftar Today (page last updated 7 Mar 2026): article describes a long-standing drainage problem in the Dadri Nagar area, with waterlogging on rainy days causing big trouble for residents; names Dadri assembly. Date is the page's last-updated date.

negatives.english: Greater Noida West lacks government school, cremation ground and parks
negatives.hindi: ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सरकारी स्कूल, श्मशान घाट और पार्क तक नहीं
negatives.basis: NCR Khabar (4 Jul 2026): residents say even one government school is missing (सरकारी स्कूल तक नसीब नहीं हुआ है), no public cremation ground, and parks/stadium/Ramlila ground are lacking; demand for a government multi-specialty hospital for 7-8 years. Dadri link to Greater Noida West taken from the 26 Jun 2026 NCR Khabar article.

negatives.english: Society maintenance charges raised, residents fear services will be cut
negatives.hindi: सोसाइटी का मेंटेनेंस बढ़ा, अब सुविधाएं कटने का डर
negatives.basis: NCR Khabar (Sep 2026, last updated 6 Sep 2026; article filed under Dadri assembly): a Greater Noida West society's maintenance charges were raised, residents are unhappy, and the maintenance company's email said non-essential services would be cut. Article says the issue has spread across Greater Noida West.

notes: AC 62 Dadri confirmed from the Wikipedia constituency list (number 62, Dadri, None, district Gautam Buddha Nagar, Lok Sabha Gautam Buddh Nagar); the Wikipedia Dadri page extent names Dadri, Kacheda Warsabad, Kamnagar, Bisrakh Jalalpur, Patwari, Chipiyana Bujurg, Chhapraula, Roza Yakubpur, Haibatpur, Dadri MB, and Surajpur in Greater Noida. Greater Noida West is stated by NCR Khabar (26 Jun 2026) to fall under Dadri. Unconfirmed AC membership: Tilpata, Kulesra, Surajpur (only the 'Dadri area' phrase in sources). Bil Akbarpur (Dadri tehsil, ETV Bharat 15 Jul 2024, drains and waterlogging) was found but excluded because its AC is not confirmed. Several Raftar Today and Amar Ujala pages show last-updated dates rather than original publication dates; dates are noted as such. Positives 2 and 3 are foundation-stone reports, so physical progress needs a field check. Most local civic sourcing is from Hindi local outlets; no Amar Ujala or Dainik Jagran Dadri civic report was reachable through search. Haryana's Dadri (Charkhi Dadri) returns many results and was excluded.
